turns.match: which of these flights suits me, the morning one or the evening one?
turns.script:
scene stack
say title | Two flights to Lisbon
say | Morning: leaves 07:10, arrives 09:40, 142 pounds.
say | Evening: leaves 18:30, arrives 21:00, 98 pounds.
ask f1 check=any pick=Morning,Evening send=yes | Which one suits you better?
